propositions: The differ and adapters each independently derive the outbound comment dedup key through separate compositions of fit/encode functions, causing convergence bugs when these compositions drift

The current dedup key predicts what wire bytes will be sent rather than being derived from the bytes actually sent, opening avoidance of the prediction-to-reality mismatch by centralizing the key derivation to fit_for_send
Both mutation-enactment consumers (create and update paths) must read wire_body from the mutation entry to send the fitted bytes matching the dedup key
The adapter's fit must remain idempotent: re-fitting an already-fitted body must return byte-identical output so the key is sound after send-time encoding
Mutation entries queued before the cutover lack wire_body and must fall back to body, preserving backward compatibility
The illegal-transition status fallback at dispatch_one.py:636 is out of scope and continues to send the adapter-fitted literal unchanged
